verdict.rationale: Exa's own SDK example shows a `startPublishedDate` date filter on search (exa-gh-9), and results carry `publishedDate` metadata (exa-docs-37). Exa describes itself as a "real-time knowledge index" it builds and maintains itself (exa-probe-1), and offers a News category (exa-docs-72) and scheduled searches that surface new events (exa-docs-10). However, only a start-date bound appears in the evidence; there is no end-date, relative recency, or livecrawl option, and no stated index refresh cadence. Missing for 10: documented end-date/range and recency parameters, a published index update frequency or freshness guarantee, and independent hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
